author: /root/render_reviewer
scope: existing main-thread platform suspended CloseRequested adaptation; not original B Suspended semantics
observations: Suspended disables frame execution in both AboutToWait/redraw. Original queued CloseRequested has no consumer until Resumed, so direct dispatch/shutdown is a real liveness repair.
Dispatch sends existing ShutdownGameCmd to current App and requests redraw; no App update or synthetic ShutdownGame is performed. Ordinary CloseRequested queue unchanged.

Existing shut_down first takes/cancels/joins preparation before renderer cleanup. GameplayPreparation::cancel_and_join drains both received and pending SubApps and disposes their actual save owners. Current App save shutdown, screenshot hurry and renderer shutdown all execute even if preparation reports failure.

Existing first error aggregation is preserved; failed dispatch/shut_down returns to run wrapper which records first error, retries cleanup and exits. Direct harness callers must likewise retain error and cleanup, not interpret lack of target.exit as success.
Successful shut_down sets shutdown_done, so later LoopExiting is idempotent. Failure does not set it, preserving retry. New branch sets target.exit only after successful shutdown.
Save close is real stop/join/drain of already queued writes; this source review does not infer a fresh simulation save snapshot without App update.
validation_limits: No Cargo, GPU or OS execution by reviewer.
Harness must prove actual loading worker pending before Suspended→Close, no Resumed, shutdown/exit and no hidden fallback; normal Close and cleanup-failure cases remain execution obligations.
Reuses author retained original B main-loop evidence for context; new change explicitly engineering platform liveness adaptation, no new original instruction extraction required.
